summary: Phase 10 Department Job Board tested end-to-end. Backend (8/8 pytest passing): GET /api/jobs gated to verified members (5 seeded postings, sorted posted_at desc, 401/403 for unauth), non-admin verified member blocked (403) from admin CRUD endpoints, admin POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/jobs work with proper 404 for missing ids, and each admin action writes audit entries (job_create/job_update/job_delete) visible via GET /api/admin/audit-log. Admin console: /admin loads for admin, all 5 tabs (overview/verification/moderation/monetization/jobs) render, Jobs tab shows create form + admin-job-{id} rows with edit/save/remove. Full UI CRUD: created TEST_UI job -> visible in admin list AND on member /api/jobs -> inline edit persisted -> delete removed it. Post-test cleanup returned admin count to seeded 5. Landing page: at 390x844 no horizontal overflow, hero + How verification works + Verify & Join Free + Department Job Board mentions all render; at 1440x900 no overflow.
